listed_quote.quote: FS KKR Capital Corp. (NYSE: FSK) and FS KKR Capital Corp. II (NYSE: FSKR), two publicly traded business development companies (“BDCs”) advised by FS/KKR

announcement.quote: FS/KKR Advisor Announces Proposed Merger of FS KKR Capital Corp. and FS KKR Capital Corp. II

outcome_evidence.quote: today announced the completion of the merger between FS KKR Capital Corp. (NYSE: FSK) and FS KKR Capital Corp. II (NYSE: FSKR).

deals.notes: Only one target (FSKR) is named by the filings in this episode. Shareholders of both funds approved on 2021-05-21 (8-K 0001193125-21-170086); the 2021-08-09 8-K (0001193125-21-240595) also states the merger completed on June 16, 2021 with FSKR merged into FSK.
